sources: Power setting "USB selective suspend" (USB settings subgroup, no alias in powercfg); 0 = disabled. A benefit for input devices is not proven, therefore "Disputed" and expert mode only.

Microsoft Learn: PowerWriteACValueIndex (powersetting.h) with the subgroup table; changes to the active plan only take effect after PowerSetActiveScheme. The value is set only for plugged in and only in the plan that is active when applying; the original value is backed up.
Confirmed read-only on the development PC (build 26200) with "powercfg /aliases" and "powercfg /query" (alias and value range).
